eventDetail.scope: The First International Conference on AI Innovations, Cyber Resilience and Transformative Applications (AIICRTA-2026) provides an international forum for researchers, academics, and industry professionals to present advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its applications, with a strong focus on cybersecurity and cyber resilience. The conference addresses both theoretical and applied aspects of AI, including machine learning, deep learning, explainable AI, and computational intelligence. It highlights applications in security, healthcare, smart cities, industry, finance, and education. Special emphasis is placed on privacy-preserving AI, secure and trustworthy systems, and AI-driven solutions for emerging cyber threats. The conference promotes interdisciplinary collaboration to advance resilient, intelligent, and secure digital systems.
